data.gender_notes: Chasheen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'chashshaana', meaning 'handsome' or 'elegant'. This name is a reflection of beauty and grace, cherished in various Muslim cultures. The name Chasheen carries the meaning “Elegant, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chasheen usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chasheen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
